selection: Best epoch chosen by macro-F1 on field validation photographs; test, external and unseen-farm photographs were not used to choose the model.

decision.note: Kept at 0.75, the value the earlier releases used. The validation rule (answers right at least 90 % of the time on field validation photographs) would allow a lower value, but lower values gave more confidently wrong answers on photographs from unfamiliar sources.

metrics.basis: Top-level figures are with the crop selected, as the app asks; all_classes lets every class compete.

fit.note: Crop selected; training photographs are scored without augmentation.

members.augmentation: random crop 30-100%, flips, 90-degree turns, brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, JPEG 35-100, blur, mixup 0.2
members.sampling: inverse square-root class frequency; field images weighted 3x studio images

training.selection: the averaged model has the best macro-F1 on field validation photographs of the candidates compared

data.split_policy: 72/12/16 deterministic split of duplicate groups (exact pixels at 64 px and 64-bit difference hash); the published PlantDoc test partition is reserved as the external field test, and the Jalgaon and Kashmir sets are reserved whole as Indian farm photographs the model never trains on
limits: Hash grouping removes copies, not different photographs of the same plant or field.
legacy_unverified images have no established source or licence and are reported separately.
Field sources come from India, Bangladesh, Ethiopia and web collections; none is a planned sample of Indian farms.
No public Indian farm set was found for wheat, potato or maize diseases beyond the small Jalgaon set.
The Odisha rice set is made of close crops; crops of the same leaf may fall on both sides of a split.

backbone_comparison.method: frozen ImageNet features, global average pooling, standardised, multinomial logistic regression
